direction: Fictional Shanghai logistics company from the dorm and shareholder side, photographed in natural light.

assets.public/art/opening/worker-bed.webp: Photorealistic Shanghai independent social-realist feature film still, horizontal 3:2. Late afternoon in a real tidy two-person employee dorm room near a warehouse in Xinzhuang, Minhang. Two well-used modern steel single bunk frames, clean cotton bedding and towels, a blue work jacket hung by the door, rice cooker, an upright wheeled duffel. Low windows showing a typical Shanghai industrial compound. Adult Chinese male warehouse lead in his 40s in a faded navy jacket with a small unbranded work pass offers a plain blue plastic room card to the unseen visitor, candid. Soft washed gray-green daylight, sober high-end cinematic natural exposure, gentle film grain. Stable spatial composition, scene centered across the middle band for UI crop. No lettering, no logos, no readable papers, no extreme poverty imagery, no overdecorated retro props.
assets.public/art/opening/worker-notice.webp: Photorealistic 3:2 narrative game photograph from a Chinese social-realist movie, early evening in a quiet ground-floor employee dorm corridor near a logistics warehouse in Xinzhuang, Shanghai. Chinese warehouse workers in everyday clean workwear, late 20s to 50s, seen mostly in profile and from behind, passing around a white printed notice held casually below eye level. One packed wheeled bag against a gray-green wall, cold fluorescent light mixed with soft peach outdoor daylight at the end of the corridor. Unposed people reading quietly and talking to one another. Balanced muted palette, authentic industrial construction, no readable writing, no brand, no heroic poses, no dirty-dystopian clichés. Compose for a center 2.2:1 crop.
assets.public/art/opening/heir-equity.webp: Realistic cinematic Shanghai drama photograph, horizontal 3:2 high-end location still. A small private family logistics company office in Lujiazui, Huangpu and opposite river bank visible in bright hazy daylight through a broad window with credible Shanghai geography. At eye level, a Chinese woman financial controller in her 40s in a plain navy work jacket opens two understated folders on pale walnut, speaking with a silver-haired Chinese founder in neat casual charcoal shirt. Neutral, familial but businesslike. Foreground empty visitor chair subtly implies player perspective. Soft limestone, unbranded objects, no tuxedos, no glamour ads, no legible text, no watermark. Mid-frame key objects for wide crop, clean fine 35mm film detail.
assets.public/art/opening/heir-vote.webp: Photorealistic high-end Chinese family company drama still 3:2. Adult Chinese private-company shareholders, five people of different ages, candidly seated in a Lujiazui Shanghai conference room in morning haze. From the player seat at the middle of a long dark walnut table, two simple cream ballot papers and an uncapped ordinary pen in foreground, people debating quietly along both sides, understated practical clothes. Small framed factory photograph on side wall. No central throne, subtle body language, convincing Shanghai office proportions, natural daylight and warm wood, grain and textured neutral colors. Meaningful foreground detail survives a wide game crop. No legible text, no logos, no designed UI.
